claims.text: Mistral announced the Voxtral Transcribe 2 family on 2026-02-04, including a realtime streaming speech-to-text model.
The realtime model was released as open weights under Apache 2.0 and described as a 4B-parameter streaming ASR model supporting 13 languages.
Latency, word-error-rate, and price/performance comparisons in the launch material are vendor claims.

claims.text: The Gemini API changelog records Gemini 3.1 Pro Preview on 2026-02-19 and a custom-tools endpoint that prioritizes user-defined tools alongside built-in execution capabilities.
The changelog records Gemini 3.1 Flash Image Preview (Nano Banana 2) on 2026-02-26 as a speed/high-volume image-generation release.
Performance and quality superiority claims associated with these previews remain vendor claims.

claims.text: Transformers v5.2.0 was published on 2026-02-16 with explicit support additions for VoxtralRealtime, GLM-5, Qwen3.5/Qwen3.5 MoE, and the VibeVoice Acoustic Tokenizer.
The VoxtralRealtime implementation describes streaming ASR using an audio encoder plus Mistral-based language-model decoder with time conditioning and causal-convolution caches.
Transformers v5.1.0 was published earlier in February and included additional model-family integrations such as GLM-OCR.
Vendor performance descriptions quoted inside the Transformers release notes are not independent Hugging Face validation.

limitations.text: Framework integration proves implementation/support landed in Transformers; it does not independently validate the model vendors’ benchmark claims.
v5.1.0 is supporting context; v5.2.0 is the materially stronger February integration milestone.
The v5.2 release also contains breaking interface changes, so model support should not be reduced to a simple compatibility list.
